name: @requestly/cross-q
description: The cross-q import engine — parse API-client collections (Postman, cURL, …) into the Requestly MappedItems shape. WebAssembly core, strings in / typed objects out.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/cq-wasm --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/cross-q/engine --out-name cross_q_engine && wasm-pack build ../../crates/cq-wasm --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/cross-q/engine-node --out-name cross_q_engine
